raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector, rolled out from 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy rows and the pipeline's existing semantics use America/Chicago local time. v2 evening transactions therefore land at 00:00-06:00 on the next day, which shifts rows into 2026-01-18 and creates a spurious partial 2026-01-19. The fix converts v2 timestamps from UTC to Chicago local time (CST, UTC-6, with no DST in January) before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
